description: This Kotlin source file defines the ContentInfoActivity class, an Android activity for displaying detailed information about a piece of content on Android TV. It handles displaying title, synopsis, image, tags, runtime, and manages focus and navigation. It also provides a static method to build intents for launching this activity with the required data.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android FragmentActivity that displays detailed content information including image, title, synopsis, tags, runtime, and focus management for Android TV.

methods.name: buildIntent
methods.description: A static method to create an intent for starting ContentInfoActivity with specified content details, focus indices, and optional tags and runtime.
